firedRules.description: Every leader is in conversation with customers >=1 hour per week, with weekly results radiated to stakeholders.
The team has launched a brand-new "hello world" program to production and discussed the experience.
The organization has bought copies of the customer's favourite book and shared with the team (org spend, not personal).
Every senior leader (BoD/CXO/VP/Dir) has read one agile change-management book and shared three takeaways.
Every product lead measures customer Net Promoter Score (NPS).
The "hello world" program has been internationalized to >=1 additional language using the user locale.
The internationalized "hello world" version has been launched to production and verified by a native speaker.
Commitment is in place from every product / project / programme / practice lead.
A 3-amigos team (business + dev + test) has shipped a real new MVP within 30 days and on budget.
Every product owner has committed to >=50% face-to-face time (or weekly-video equivalent for remote teams).
A new "fizz buzz" program has been created and shipped to production.
All staff have a sustaining budget for >=1 year secured.
Quality-attribute metrics are wired into pre-commit hooks and continuous integration.
Every product team has >=2 people with process-improvement skills (Lean / Six Sigma / VSM / TPS / TPC).
A 5-point Likert "our team is self-organizing" averages "Agree" or better.
Every leader has shared their previous 2 retrospectives with all stakeholders.
Total 9/16 places the organization in the "medium" readiness band.

additionalFlags.description: Customer-contact gap: leaders are not in regular conversation with customers, or NPS is not measured.
additionalFlags.suggestedAction: Establish weekly customer conversations for every product lead and stand up a basic NPS measurement.

additionalFlags.description: Principle 11 not satisfied: self-organization Likert average is below "Agree".
additionalFlags.suggestedAction: Run a focused self-organization improvement initiative (e.g. The Vanguard Method) before hiring agile coaches.
